        function addToBatch(imageOverride = null) {
            const text = DOMElements.messageInput.value.trim();
            if (!text && !imageOverride) return;
            batchMessages.push({
                id: Date.now() + batchMessages.length, text: text || '', image: imageOverride || null

function updateBatchPreview() {
            const previewContainer = DOMElements.batchPreview;
            if (!previewContainer) return;
            previewContainer.replaceChildren();

            const title = document.createElement('div');
            title.className = 'batch-preview-title';
            title.textContent = '我有很多的话想说…！';

            const top = document.createElement('div');

window.addEventListener('message', function(ev){
var frame=document.getElementById('xiaoshuBigKeyboardFrame');
if(!frame||ev.source!==frame.contentWindow)return;
var d = ev && ev.data;
if(d === 'xiaoshu-close-big-keyboard' || (d && d.type === 'xiaoshu-close-big-keyboard')){
closeBigKeyboard(false);
return;
}
if(d&&d.type==='xiaoshu-big-keyboard-storage-request'){
sendBigKeyboardStorage(frame);
return;
}
if(d&&d.type==='xiaoshu-big-keyboard-stickers-request'){
sendBigKeyboardStickers(frame);
return;
}
if(d&&d.type==='xiaoshu-big-keyboard-sticker-upload'){
try{
if(window.xiaoshuStickerStore&&typeof window.xiaoshuStickerStore.openUpload==='function')window.xiaoshuStickerStore.openUpload();
else if(typeof window.xiaoshuOpenSharedStickerUpload==='function')window.xiaoshuOpenSharedStickerUpload();
}catch(err){try{console.error('[大键盘] 打开表情上传失败',err);}catch(_e){}}
return;
}
if(d&&d.type==='xiaoshu-big-keyboard-sticker-hide'){
var sticker=String(d.sticker||'').trim();
if(sticker){
try{
if(window.xiaoshuStickerStore&&typeof window.xiaoshuStickerStore.hide==='function')window.xiaoshuStickerStore.hide(sticker,true);
else if(typeof window.xiaoshuHideStickerNow==='function')window.xiaoshuHideStickerNow(sticker,true);
}catch(err){try{console.error('[大键盘] 隐藏表情失败',err);}catch(_e){}}
}

}

if(String(d.key||'')!==BIG_KEYBOARD_STORE_KEY)return;
try{if(d.value==null)localStorage.removeItem(BIG_KEYBOARD_STORE_KEY);else localStorage.setItem(BIG_KEYBOARD_STORE_KEY,String(d.value));}catch(err){try{console.error('[大键盘] 父页存储写入失败',err);}catch(_e){}}
}
});
window.addEventListener('stickerLibraryUpdated',function(){var frame=document.getElementById('xiaoshuBigKeyboardFrame');if(frame&&loaded)sendBigKeyboardStickers(frame);});
window.addEventListener('popstate', function(){ if(pushed) closeBigKeyboard(true); });
})();

function deepMerge(target, src){
target = target && typeof target === 'object' ? target : {};
src = src && typeof src === 'object' ? src : {};
Object.keys(src).forEach(k=>{
if(k==='__proto__'||k==='prototype'||k==='constructor') return;
if(src[k] && typeof src[k]==='object' && !Array.isArray(src[k])){
if(!target[k] || typeof target[k] !== 'object' || Array.isArray(target[k])) target[k]={};
deepMerge(target[k], src[k]);
}else if(target[k]===undefined){
target[k]=src[k];
}
});
return target;
}
function kkk35gNormalizeLegacyBeautyId(value){
const legacy=String.fromCharCode(122,121,51);
return typeof value==='string' ? value.replace(new RegExp(legacy,'ig'),'kkk35g') : value;
}

'builtin_parent_builtin_xiaoshu_qq_xiaotugao_text_bubble_fixed_v2'
]);
function kkk35gMigrateLegacyBeautyState(){

if(state.activeBeautyId.startsWith('builtin:')&&KKK35G_REMOVED_KEYBOARD_BEAUTY_IDS.has(state.activeBeautyId.slice(8)))state.activeBeautyId='';
state.beautyHiddenBuiltins=(state.beautyHiddenBuiltins||[]).map(kkk35gNormalizeLegacyBeautyId).filter(function(id){return !KKK35G_REMOVED_KEYBOARD_BEAUTY_IDS.has(id);});

state.beautyBuiltinEdits=migrated;
}

function safeAssignOwn(target, source, allowed){

function safeResourceUrl(value, kind='image'){
  const raw = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
  if(!raw || /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/.test(raw)) return '';
  if(/^blob:/i.test(raw) || /^https?:\/\//i.test(raw) || /^(file|content):/i.test(raw)) return raw;
  if(kind === 'video' && /^data:video\/[a-z0-9.+-]+(?:;[^,]*)?,/i.test(raw)) return raw;
  if(kind === 'audio' && /^data:audio\/[a-z0-9.+-]+(?:;[^,]*)?,/i.test(raw)) return raw;
  if(/^data:image\/[a-z0-9.+-]+(?:;[^,]*)?,/i.test(raw)) return raw;
  return '';
}
function safeCssUrl(value){
  const safe = safeResourceUrl(value, 'image');
  return safe ? 'url("' + safe.replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/"/g,'\\"').replace(/[\r\n]/g,'') + '")' : '';
}

}

}

function compressImage(file, max=900, quality=.82){
  return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
    const fr = new FileReader();
    fr.onload = () => {
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => {
        let w=img.width,h=img.height;
        if(w>h && w>max){ h = Math.round(h*max/w); w=max; }
        else if(h>=w && h>max){ w = Math.round(w*max/h); h=max; }
        const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=w; c.height=h;
        const ctx = c.getContext('2d'); ctx.drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);
        resolve(c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality));
      };
      img.onerror = reject; img.src = fr.result;
    };
    fr.onerror = reject; fr.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}
function readFileAsDataURL(file){
  return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
    const fr = new FileReader();
    fr.onload = ()=>resolve(fr.result);
    fr.onerror = reject;
    fr.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

function compressImage(file, max=900, quality=.82){
  return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
    const fr = new FileReader();
    fr.onload = () => {
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => {
        let w=img.width,h=img.height;
        if(w>h && w>max){ h = Math.round(h*max/w); w=max; }
        else if(h>=w && h>max){ w = Math.round(w*max/h); h=max; }
        const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=w; c.height=h;
        const ctx = c.getContext('2d'); ctx.drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);
        resolve(c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality));
      };
      img.onerror = reject; img.src = fr.result;
    };
    fr.onerror = reject; fr.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}
function readFileAsDataURL(file){
  return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
    const fr = new FileReader();
    fr.onload = ()=>resolve(fr.result);
    fr.onerror = reject;
    fr.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}
async function buildMediaItem(file){
  if(file.type.startsWith('image/')){
    const src = await compressImage(file, 1080, .84);
    return { id:'m_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2), type:'image', src };
  }
  if(file.type.startsWith('video/')){
    if(file.size > 2.5 * 1024 * 1024) throw new Error('视频太大了，先试试更短一点的视频。');
    const src = await readFileAsDataURL(file);
    return { id:'m_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2), type:'video', src };
  }
  throw new Error('暂时只支持图片和视频');
}
function mediaGridClass(media){
  const count = Math.max(0, (media||[]).length);
  if(count <= 1) return 'media-grid single';
  return `media-grid multi count-${Math.min(count, 9)}`;
}
let renderMediaHtml = function renderMediaHtmlBase(media, extraClass='', postId=''){
  media = media || [];
  if(!media.length) return '';
  const openAttr = postId ? ` data-open-viewer="${escapeAttr(postId)}" role="button" tabindex="0"` : '';
  return `<div class="post-media ${extraClass}"${openAttr}><div class="${mediaGridClass(media)}">` + media.map(item=>{
    if(item.type === 'video'){
      return `<div class="media-item"><video controls playsinline preload="metadata" src="${escapeAttr(safeResourceUrl(item.src, item.type === 'video' ? 'video' : 'image'))}"></video><span class="media-badge">视频</span></div>`;
    }
    return `<div class="media-item"><img src="${escapeAttr(safeResourceUrl(item.src, item.type === 'video' ? 'video' : 'image'))}" alt=""></div>`;
  }).join('') + `</div></div>`;
};
function applyFeedTextCollapse(){
  const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-collapsible-post]')];
  items.forEach(el=>{
    const id = el.getAttribute('data-collapsible-post');
    const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-expand-post]')].find(node => node.getAttribute('data-expand-post') === id);
    if(!btn) return;
    btn.textContent = '全文';
    btn.dataset.expanded = 'false';
    if(expandedFeedPosts.has(id)){
      el.classList.remove('collapsed');
      btn.classList.remove('show');
      btn.dataset.expanded = 'true';
      return;
    }
    el.classList.remove('collapsed');
    const style = getComputedStyle(el);
    const lineHeight = parseFloat(style.lineHeight) || 24;
    const fullHeight = el.scrollHeight;
    if(fullHeight > lineHeight * 7 + 2){
      el.classList.add('collapsed');
      btn.classList.add('show');
    }else{
      btn.classList.remove('show');
    }
  });
}

function formatCommentHtml(c){
  const authorName = c.authorName || authorNameByKey(c.author);
  const replyName = c.replyToName || (c.replyTo ? authorNameByKey(c.replyTo) : '');
  const prefix = replyName
    ? `<span class="social-name">${escapeHtml(authorName)}</span><span class="social-reply-word">回复</span><span class="social-name">${escapeHtml(replyName)}</span><span class="social-colon">:</span>`
    : `<span class="social-name">${escapeHtml(authorName)}</span><span class="social-colon">:</span>`;
  return `${prefix}${escapeHtml(c.text)}`;
}
function renderSocialBox(post, mode='feed'){
  const likeUsers = getLikeUsers(post);
  const likes = likeUsers.map(user=>user.name);
  const comments = post.comments || [];
  if(!likes.length && !comments.length) return '';
  const lines = [];
  if(likes.length){
    if(mode === 'detail'){
      lines.push(`<div class="social-line social-like-line"><span class="social-heart">♡</span><span class="social-like-avatars">${likeUsers.map(renderLikeAvatar).join('')}</span></div>`);
    }else{
      lines.push(`<div class="social-line social-like-line"><span class="social-heart">♡</span><span class="social-like-names">${escapeHtml(likes.join('，'))}</span></div>`);
    }
  }
  comments.forEach(c=>{
    const inner = formatCommentHtml(c);
    if(mode === 'detail'){
      lines.push(`<button type="button" class="social-line social-comment-btn" data-reply-comment="${c.id}">${inner}</button>`);
    }else{
      lines.push(`<div class="social-line">${inner}</div>`);
    }
  });
  return `<div class="social-box">${lines.join('')}</div>`;
}

function planNextOtherPost(force=false){
  if(state.autoPost !== 'on' || !(state.dynamicCards||[]).length){ state.nextOtherPostAt = 0; save(); updateNextHint(); return; }
  if(state.nextOtherPostAt && !force) return;

  save(); updateNextHint();
}
function updateNextHint(){
  const el = qs('#nextPostHint'); if(!el) return;
  if(state.autoPost !== 'on'){ el.textContent='当前自动发动态已关闭。'; return; }
  if(!state.nextOtherPostAt){ el.textContent='还没有排好下一条动态。'; return; }
  const ms = state.nextOtherPostAt - Date.now();
  if(ms <= 0){ el.textContent='下一条动态即将发出。'; return; }
  const mins = Math.floor(ms/60000), secs = Math.floor((ms%60000)/1000);
  el.textContent = `下一条动态预计在 ${mins} 分 ${secs} 秒后发出。`;
}

function getProfileTimelineDateLabel(ts){
  const d = new Date(ts);
  const now = new Date();
  const todayStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate()).getTime();
  const dateStart = new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate()).getTime();
  const diffDays = Math.round((todayStart - dateStart) / 86400000);
  if(diffDays === 0) return '今天';
  if(diffDays === 1) return '昨天';
  return d.getFullYear() === now.getFullYear() ? `${d.getMonth()+1}月${d.getDate()}日` : `${d.getFullYear()}年${d.getMonth()+1}月${d.getDate()}日`;
}
function renderTimelinePreviewMedia(media){
  media = (media || []).filter(Boolean);
  if(!media.length) return '';
  const items = media.slice(0, 9);
  const count = items.length;
  const cols = count === 1 ? 1 : (count === 2 || count === 4 ? 2 : 3);
  return `<div class="timeline-thumb-grid cols-${cols}">` + items.map((item, index)=>{
    const moreCount = media.length - 9;
    const isLastVisible = index === items.length - 1;
    const moreHtml = moreCount > 0 && isLastVisible ? `<span class="timeline-thumb-more">+${moreCount}</span>` : '';
    const badgeHtml = item.type === 'video' ? `<span class="timeline-video-badge">视频</span>` : '';
    if(item.type === 'video'){
      return `<div class="timeline-thumb-item"><video muted playsinline preload="metadata" src="${escapeAttr(safeResourceUrl(item.src, item.type === 'video' ? 'video' : 'image'))}"></video>${badgeHtml}${moreHtml}</div>`;
    }
    return `<div class="timeline-thumb-item"><img src="${escapeAttr(safeResourceUrl(item.src, item.type === 'video' ? 'video' : 'image'))}" alt="">${moreHtml}</div>`;
  }).join('') + `</div>`;
}

    const label = getProfileTimelineDateLabel(post.ts);
    const last = groups[groups.length - 1];
    if(last && last.label === label){
      last.posts.push(post);
    }else{

      const hasMedia = !!((post.media||[]).length);

    }).join('');
    return `<div class="timeline-group"><div class="timeline-date">${group.label}</div><div class="timeline-group-items">${postsHtml}</div></div>`;
  }).join('');
}

  function countTypes(list){
    var out = { pure:0, sticker:0, image:0, video:0, audio:0, card:0, poke:0, system:0, other:0 };
    list.forEach(function(m){
      if (isPoke(m)) out.poke++;
      else if (isSticker(m)) out.sticker++;
      else if (isVideo(m)) out.video++;
      else if (isAudio(m)) out.audio++;
      else if (isImage(m)) out.image++;
      else if (isCard(m)) out.card++;
      else if (isPureText(m)) out.pure++;
      else if (m && m.type === 'system') out.system++;
      else out.other++;
    });
    return out;
  }
  function freq(items, getter, limit){
    var map = Object.create(null);
    items.forEach(function(item){
      var values = getter(item);
      if (!Array.isArray(values)) values = [values];
      values.forEach(function(value){ value = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim(); if (value) map[value] = (map[value] || 0) + 1; });
    });
    return Object.keys(map).map(function(k){ return { text:k, count:map[k] }; }).sort(function(a,b){ return b.count-a.count || a.text.localeCompare(b.text,'zh-CN'); }).slice(0, limit || 8);
  }
  function rankRows(items, emptyText){
    if (!items.length) return '<div class="xs-stats-empty"><i class="fas fa-inbox"></i><b>暂无数据</b><span>'+esc(emptyText || '还没有可统计的内容')+'</span></div>';
    var max = items[0].count || 1;
    return '<div class="xs-stats-rank-list">'+items.map(function(item, i){
      var pct = Math.max(7, Math.round(item.count / max * 100));
      return '<div class="xs-stats-rank-row"><div class="xs-stats-rank-bg" style="width:'+pct+'%"></div><span class="xs-stats-rank-no">#'+(i+1)+'</span><span class="xs-stats-rank-text" title="'+esc(item.text)+'">'+esc(item.text)+'</span><b>'+item.count+'次</b></div>';
    }).join('')+'</div>';
  }

}

function pressKey(k){
  const low=String(k).toLowerCase();
  if(low==='backspace')inputText=inputText.slice(0,-1);
  else if(low==='space')inputText+=' ';
  else if(low==='enter')inputText+='\n';
  else if(low==='clear')inputText='';
  else inputText+=k;
  updateInput();
}
function renderKeyboard(){

  const box=$('keyRows');box.innerHTML='';

    const r=document.createElement('div');r.className='key-row';
    row.forEach(k=>{
      const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='key';b.textContent=labelForKey(k);
      const low=k.toLowerCase();if(['backspace','enter','clear'].includes(low))b.classList.add('action','wide');if(low==='space')b.classList.add('space');
      b.onclick=()=>pressKey(k);r.appendChild(b);
    });box.appendChild(r);
  });
}

function fallbackRead(k){var ls=safeLS(),pk=prefix()+k;if(ls){var raw=ls.getItem(pk);if(raw!==null)return {found:true,value:decode(raw)};}if(memory.has(k))return {found:true,value:memory.get(k)};return {found:false,value:null};}
function fallbackGet(k){return Promise.resolve(fallbackRead(k).value);}
function fallbackSet(k,v){if(typeof Blob!=='undefined'&&v instanceof Blob)return Promise.reject(new Error('IndexedDB不可用，无法安全保存二进制Blob'));var ls=safeLS();v=v===undefined?null:v;memory.set(k,v);if(ls)ls.setItem(prefix()+k,encode(v));return Promise.resolve(v);}
function fallbackRemove(k){var ls=safeLS();memory.delete(k);if(ls)ls.removeItem(prefix()+k);return Promise.resolve();}
function fallbackKeys(){var ls=safeLS(),set=new Set(memory.keys()),p=prefix();if(ls){for(var i=0;i<ls.length;i++){var k=ls.key(i);if(k&&k.indexOf(p)===0)set.add(k.slice(p.length));}}return Promise.resolve(Array.from(set));}
function migrateFallbackValue(db,key,value){return new Promise(function(resolve){try{var tx=db.transaction(cfg.storeName,'readwrite');tx.objectStore(cfg.storeName).put(value,key);tx.oncomplete=function(){fallbackRemove(key).then(function(){resolve(value)},function(){resolve(value)});};tx.onerror=tx.onabort=function(){resolve(value);};}catch(e){resolve(value);}});}
function open(){
if(forceFallback||!global.indexedDB)return Promise.reject(new Error('IndexedDB unavailable'));
if(dbPromise)return dbPromise;
dbPromise=new Promise(function(resolve,reject){
var req;
try{req=global.indexedDB.open(String(cfg.name||'localforage'));}catch(e){reject(e);return;}
req.onupgradeneeded=function(){var db=req.result;if(!db.objectStoreNames.contains(cfg.storeName))db.createObjectStore(cfg.storeName);};
req.onerror=function(){reject(req.error||new Error('IndexedDB open failed'));};
req.onblocked=function(){reject(new Error('IndexedDB open blocked'));};
req.onsuccess=function(){var db=req.result;
if(!db.objectStoreNames.contains(cfg.storeName)){
var nextVersion=db.version+1;db.close();dbPromise=null;
try{
var up=global.indexedDB.open(String(cfg.name||'localforage'),nextVersion);
up.onupgradeneeded=function(){if(!up.result.objectStoreNames.contains(cfg.storeName))up.result.createObjectStore(cfg.storeName);};
up.onerror=function(){reject(up.error||new Error('IndexedDB store upgrade failed'));};
up.onsuccess=function(){resolve(up.result);};
}catch(e){reject(e);}
}else resolve(db);
};
}).catch(function(e){forceFallback=true;dbPromise=null;throw e;});
return dbPromise;
}
function withStore(mode,fn){
return open().then(function(db){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){
var tx,store,request,result;
try{tx=db.transaction(cfg.storeName,mode);store=tx.objectStore(cfg.storeName);request=fn(store);}
catch(e){reject(e);return;}
if(request&&typeof request==='object'&&'onsuccess' in request){request.onsuccess=function(){result=request.result;};request.onerror=function(){reject(request.error||new Error('IndexedDB request failed'));};}
tx.oncomplete=function(){resolve(result);};tx.onerror=tx.onabort=function(){reject(tx.error||new Error('IndexedDB transaction failed'));};
});}).catch(function(){return null;});
}

function safeAssignOwn(target, source, allowedKeys) {

const allow = allowedKeys ? new Set(allowedKeys) : null;
Object.keys(source).forEach(function(key) {

function deduplicateContentArray(arr, baseSystemArray = []) {
const seen = new Set(baseSystemArray.map(normalizeStringStrict));

removedCount++;
}
}

}

if (typeof s !== 'string') return '';
return s.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}
function safeAssignOwn(target, source, allowedKeys) {
if (!target || !source || typeof source !== 'object') return target;
const allow = allowedKeys ? new Set(allowedKeys) : null;
Object.keys(source).forEach(function(key) {
if (key === '__proto__' || key === 'prototype' || key === 'constructor') return;
if (allow && !allow.has(key)) return;
try { target[key] = source[key]; } catch (e) {}
});
return target;
}
function deduplicateContentArray(arr, baseSystemArray = []) {
const seen = new Set(baseSystemArray.map(normalizeStringStrict));
const result = [];
let removedCount = 0;
for (const item of arr) {
const norm = normalizeStringStrict(item);
if (norm !== '' && !seen.has(norm)) {
seen.add(norm);
result.push(item);
} else {
removedCount++;
}
}
return { result, removedCount };
}
function cropImageToSquare(file, maxSize = 640) {
return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
const reader = new FileReader();
reader.onload = (e) => {
const img = new Image();
img.onload = () => {
const minSide = Math.min(img.width, img.height);
const sx = (img.width - minSide) / 2;
const sy = (img.height - minSide) / 2;
const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
canvas.width = maxSize; canvas.height = maxSize;
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
ctx.drawImage(img, sx, sy, minSide, minSide, 0, 0, maxSize, maxSize);
resolve(canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.95));
};
img.onerror = reject;
img.src = e.target.result;
};
reader.onerror = reject;
reader.readAsDataURL(file);
});
}
function exportDataToMobileOrPC(dataString, fileName) {
if (navigator.share && navigator.canShare) {
try {
const blob = new Blob([dataString], { type: 'application/json' });
const file = new File([blob], fileName, { type: 'application/json' });
if (navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) {
navigator.share({ files: [file], title: '传讯数据备份', text: '请选择"保存到文件"' })
.catch(() => downloadFileFallback(blob, fileName));
return;
}
} catch (e) {}
}
const blob = new Blob([dataString], { type: 'application/json' });
downloadFileFallback(blob, fileName);
}
function downloadFileFallback(blob, fileName) {

const link = document.createElement('a');
link.href = url; link.download = fileName; link.style.display = 'none';
document.body.appendChild(link); link.click(); document.body.removeChild(link);
setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 2000);
}

function pressKey(k){
  const low=String(k).toLowerCase();
  if(low==='backspace')inputText=inputText.slice(0,-1);
  else if(low==='space')inputText+=' ';
  else if(low==='enter')inputText+='\n';
  else if(low==='clear')inputText='';
  else inputText+=k;
  updateInput();
}
function renderKeyboard(){
  const rows=splitRows(state.rows.keyboard.me[currentPage]);
  const box=$('keyRows');box.innerHTML='';
  rows.forEach(row=>{
    const r=document.createElement('div');r.className='key-row';
    row.forEach(k=>{
      const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='key';b.textContent=labelForKey(k);
      const low=k.toLowerCase();if(['backspace','enter','clear'].includes(low))b.classList.add('action','wide');if(low==='space')b.classList.add('space');
      b.onclick=()=>pressKey(k);r.appendChild(b);
    });box.appendChild(r);
  });
}

function deepMerge(target, src){
target = target && typeof target === 'object' ? target : {};
src = src && typeof src === 'object' ? src : {};
Object.keys(src).forEach(k=>{
if(k==='__proto__'||k==='prototype'||k==='constructor') return;
if(src[k] && typeof src[k]==='object' && !Array.isArray(src[k])){
if(!target[k] || typeof target[k] !== 'object' || Array.isArray(target[k])) target[k]={};
deepMerge(target[k], src[k]);
}else if(target[k]===undefined){
target[k]=src[k];
}
});
return target;
}

async function importKeyboardBeautyZip(input){
const f=input.files&&input.files[0];if(!f)return;
try{
const SharedJSZip=(typeof window.xiaoshuChat2GetJSZip==='function'?window.xiaoshuChat2GetJSZip():null);
if(!SharedJSZip){alert('压缩包组件没有加载完成，请重新打开聊天2后再试。');input.value='';return;}
const buf=await f.arrayBuffer();
const zip=await SharedJSZip.loadAsync(buf);
const names=Object.keys(zip.files).filter(n=>!zip.files[n].dir&&/\.css$/i.test(n)&&!/(^|\/)__MACOSX\//.test(n));
let count=0;
for(const n of names){const css=await zip.files[n].async('text');upsertKeyboardBeautyCss(n,css);count++;}
save();renderKeyboardBeautyManager();alert('已导入 '+count+' 个 CSS');
}catch(e){console.error(e);alert('导入压缩包失败：'+(e&&e.message?e.message:e));}
input.value='';
}

function importKeyboardBeautyLibrary(input){

try{
const data=JSON.parse(String(r.result||'{}'));
if(data.type&&data.type!=='xiaoshu-standalone-keyboard-beauty')throw new Error('不是聊天2美化库备份');
if(data.type==='xiaoshu-standalone-keyboard-beauty'&&Number(data.version||0)>1)throw new Error('美化库备份版本过高');
if(!data.type&&!Array.isArray(data.customStyles))throw new Error('不是聊天2美化库备份');
state.beautyCustomStyles=Array.isArray(data.customStyles)?data.customStyles:[];
state.beautyBuiltinEdits=data.builtinEdits||{};
state.beautyHiddenBuiltins=Array.isArray(data.hiddenBuiltins)?data.hiddenBuiltins:[];
state.activeBeautyId=data.activeBeautyId||'';
kkk35gMigrateLegacyBeautyState();
if(save()===false)throw new Error('美化库写入失败');applyActiveKeyboardBeauty();renderKeyboardBeautyManager();alert('美化库已导入');
}catch(e){alert('导入失败：'+(e&&e.message?e.message:e));}
input.value='';
};
r.readAsText(f,'utf-8');
}

function largeCanvasSize(){
const v=largeViewport();
return {w:Math.max(1,v?v.clientWidth:360),h:Math.max(1,v?v.clientHeight:480)};

function clampLargeView(view){
const s=largeCanvasSize();
view.scale=clamp(Number(view.scale)||1,.75,8);
const sw=s.w*view.scale,sh=s.h*view.scale;
view.tx=sw<=s.w?(s.w-sw)/2:clamp(Number(view.tx)||0,s.w-sw,0);
view.ty=sh<=s.h?(s.h-sh)/2:clamp(Number(view.ty)||0,s.h-sh,0);
}
function applyLargeView(){
const view=getCanvasViewState('me','editor'),scene=largeScene();if(!scene)return;
clampLargeView(view);
scene.style.transform=`translate3d(${view.tx}px,${view.ty}px,0) scale(${view.scale})`;
const label=$('largeZoomLabel');if(label)label.textContent=Math.round(view.scale*100)+'%';
}
function setLargeViewScale(next,focusX,focusY){
const view=getCanvasViewState('me','editor'),s=largeCanvasSize();
focusX=focusX??s.w/2;focusY=focusY??s.h/2;
const old=Math.max(.001,view.scale),ns=clamp(next,.75,8),ratio=ns/old;
view.tx=focusX-(focusX-view.tx)*ratio;view.ty=focusY-(focusY-view.ty)*ratio;view.scale=ns;applyLargeView();
}

function updateStats() {

var processLS = function () {
for (var i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
var k = localStorage.key(i) || '';

total += bytes;

else if (v.startsWith('data:image') || v.startsWith('data:video')) media += bytes;
else cfg += bytes;
}
Promise.resolve(navigator.storage&&navigator.storage.estimate?navigator.storage.estimate():null).then(function(est){applyStats(total,msgs,cfg,media,est&&est.quota,est&&est.usage);}).catch(function(){applyStats(total,msgs,cfg,media,0,0);});

return localforage.getItem(k).then(function (raw) {
if (raw == null) return { k: k, b: 0 };
var str = typeof raw === 'string' ? raw : JSON.stringify(raw);
return { k: k, b: (k.length + str.length) * 2 };
});
});
Promise.all(promises).then(function (results) {
results.forEach(function (r) {
total += r.b;
if (/messages|msgs|session/i.test(r.k)) msgs += r.b;
else if (/avatar|image|photo|bg|background|wallpaper/i.test(r.k)) media += r.b;
else cfg += r.b;
});

}).catch(processLS);
}).catch(processLS);
} else { processLS(); }
} catch (e) { processLS(); }
}
